subject: Flashcards with FSRS (ts-fsrs 6 + Python fsrs parity), review screen, create/edit
body: Brief: docs/segments/10-cards-fsrs.md. Own cloud session. S06 (ContentRenderer) and S12a (InkCanvas) are in rework: use their public APIs only and coordinate on the ledger with seg06-reader / seg12-ink. Attempt gate: S08 is changing the flashcards policy to require a graded attempt (chosen and correct not null) — your service-role due-list code must apply the same rule. Mount S12b's card ink hook when seg12b-ink lands it. Turn on S08's 'Save as flashcard' and the Builder 'Flashcards · N due' link (coordinate with seg08). Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md.
